response.overview: In 2015, Saïd Ramzy, a young journalist, infiltrated a small French jihadist group, which had pledged allegiance to Daesh. The group, called "The Soldiers of Allah", reaches another dimension when an individual arrives from Syria and takes command of them. Invisible but very active, the man prepares a mass attack comparable to that of the Bataclan. This high-risk infiltration of Said Ramzy will make it possible to trace the network and discover the true identity of the dangerous leader. The latter is responsible for the unsuccessful terrorist attack of September 2016, near Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris, using a car bomb by a commando of female jihadists
response.title: I infiltrated Daesh in France
